subject: reasoning
question: Seven girls A, B, C, X, Y, W and Z are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). W is second to the left of X. W is the immediate neighbour of both B and C. Z is fourth to the left of B. Y is not the immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate left of X?
solution:
**Given :** Seven girls A, B, C, X, Y, W and Z are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

**Explanation :**

1) W is second to the left of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19705939da13058fc8e5de3aa4d084bfdbb1e7aef12e6fdd8b49dc53569fd6d0.png] 

2) W is the immediate neighbour of both B and C.</p&g
